title: Crew Rotation
goal: Hand the base over to the new crew.

rotation.legend.title: BASE LEGEND
rotation.legend.text: You lifted off cleanly, kept everyone healthy and handed over a thriving base. Artemis Base will remember you for a long time.

rotation.science.title: SCIENCE PIONEERS
rotation.science.text: Your extra science gear gave Earth a treasure of lunar data. Scientists will be studying it for years.

rotation.legacy.title: MESSAGE FOR THE FUTURE
rotation.legacy.text: You left a time capsule and a heartfelt note. Someday visitors to Artemis Base will read your words.

rotation.quiet.title: QUIET SUCCESS
rotation.quiet.text: It wasn't always smooth, but you kept the crew alive and the base running. That's what a commander does.
